title: 第7章 杀机第8章 给我起
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 翌日。
东方既白。
沈修寒推门出屋。
院角的水缸里，水面结了一层薄冰。
沈修寒抄起木棍捅碎冰壳，舀一瓢冰水，劈头泼在脸上。
寒意如针，残存的困意顿时消散得干干净净。
屋里头，沈沫沫还蜷在被窝里睡得香甜。
郑氏却早已起来，在庖屋操持早食，院中还隐约能听见柴火燃烧的噼啪响。
沈修寒呼出一口白气，转身回屋。
在床沿坐下，心念微动。
【本日情报已刷新！】
『情报』、『推演』、『箴言』、『还魂』…
沈修寒眉头微皱。
察觉到系统相比昨日，赫然多了四个金色选项。
沈修寒逐一试过，却无奈发现除了『情报』能打开，其余三字皆如水中倒影，触之即散。
片刻后，系统传来模糊反馈：
『推演』，需积攒十五日不动用『情报』，方可开启。
『谶言』，需半载。
『还魂』…需整整一年。
得，那还说什么？
“打开今日情报！”
唰！
眼前光景骤变。
数道淡金色光点凭空浮现。
【情报1：麻显阳，通背武馆内院三弟子，困于‘练血’已两载有余，欲依靠宝鱼突破瓶颈。】
【昨日偶见你所捕银纹鱼，五纹、六纹竟有数尾，断定你必知银背宝鱼藏身之处！】
【彼时高价买鱼、遣陈安送你归家，皆是为麻痹于你，令你放下戒心。实则，已拜托金龙帮连夜于内城门、鱼市、鱼栏各处布下眼线。】
【一旦你携宝鱼现身，为防白氏染指，将你诓至无人处，截杀夺鱼！】
嗡！
沈修寒脑中轰然一响，瞳孔骤然缩成针尖！
麻显阳…
要杀我！？
昨日豪气干云的做派，竟全是他伪装出来的？
沈修寒倒吸了一口凉气，脊背陡然窜起一阵寒意。
情报言明，此人困于练血已久，欲仰仗宝鱼冲关。
想来他定是打探过各类宝鱼的底细，知晓银背鱼的习性特点，自然也不足为奇了。
又因我是白氏佃户…
content_en:
The next day.
The east is white.
Shen Xiuhan opened the door and left the house.
In the water tank in the corner of the courtyard, a thin layer of ice formed on the water.
Shen Xiuhan picked up a wooden stick and smashed the ice shell, scooped up a ladle of ice water and splashed it on his face.
The chill was like needles, and the remaining sleepiness immediately dissipated completely.
In the room, Shen Momo was still curled up in the quilt and sleeping soundly.
However, Mrs. Zheng had already gotten up and was preparing breakfast in the restaurant. The crackling sound of firewood could still be heard faintly in the courtyard.
Shen Xiuhan exhaled a breath of white air and turned around to go back to the house.
Sitting on the edge of the bed, my mind moved slightly.
[Today’s information has been refreshed! 】
"Intelligence", "Deduction", "Proverbs", "Resurrection"...
"Huh?"
Shen Xiuhan frowned slightly.
I noticed that compared to yesterday, the system had four more golden options.
Shen Xiuhan tried them one by one, but found that except for "Intelligence", which could be opened, the other three words were like reflections in the water, and they dispersed when touched.
After a while, vague feedback came from the system:
"Deduction" can only be opened after accumulating "Intelligence" for fifteen days without using it.
"Prophecy" takes half a year.
"Resurrection"... takes a full year.
Yes, what else can you say?
"Open today's information!"
Uh-huh!
The scene before his eyes suddenly changed.
Several pale golden light spots appeared out of thin air.
[Information 1: Ma Xianyang, the third disciple in the inner courtyard of Tongbei Martial Arts School, has been trapped in "blood training" for more than two years, and wants to rely on Baoyu to break through the bottleneck. 】
[I saw the silver-backed fish you caught yesterday, and there were quite a few of them with five or six stripes. I concluded that you must know where the silver-backed treasure fish is hiding! 】
[At that time, I bought fish at a high price and sent Chen An to take you home, all to numb you and make you let down your guard. In fact, the Golden Dragon Gang has been asked to set up spies at the inner city gate, fish market, and fish pens overnight. 】
[Once you show up with the treasure fish, in order to prevent the Bai family from getting involved, you will be lured to a deserted place and the fish will be intercepted and killed! 】
Buzz!
There was a loud bang in Shen Xiuhan's mind, and his pupils suddenly shrank into needlepoints!
Ma Xianyang…
Want to kill me! ?
Yesterday's heroic Qianyun behavior was all faked by him?
Shen Xiuhan took a breath of cold air, and a chill suddenly ran down his spine.
The intelligence revealed that this person had been trapped in blood training for a long time and wanted to rely on Baoyu to clear the barrier.
Presumably, he must have inquired about the details of various types of treasure fish, and it is not surprising that he knows the habits and characteristics of silverback fish.
And because I am a tenant of the Bai family...
